title: nf-core/fspfinalqc pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fasta.errorMessage: Fasta file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fa.gz' or '.fasta.gz' or '.fa' or '.fasta'

busco_full_table.errorMessage: This is the previously generated busco full table corresponding to the input fasta file. BUSCO full table file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.tsv'

btk_results_directory.errorMessage: This is the directory containing the results produced with BlobToolKit viewer during the manual decontamination, following the FSP protocol. It's a directory that cannot contain spaces. The directory must contain the following files: '*_taxonomy.csv', '*_core.csv', and 9 PNG files.
